verses.t: Let the Maruts drink Trishtups from the Potar's cup, according to the season Soma from heaven.
Let Agni from the Kindler's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.
Let Indra the Brāhman from the Brāhman's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.
Let the God, Granter of Wealth, from the Potar's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.
